lastResponse.text: I hear you. If you can’t breathe right now, this is an emergency, so call nine one one now or tell someone right next to you to call nine one one for you. Move to the quietest spot you can, sit down, and take slow breaths with me: in through your nose, out through your mouth. I’m staying with you, and I’m getting a live agent now.
originalTexts: I hear you. If you can’t breathe right now, this is an emergency, so call **911** now or tell someone right next to you to call **911** for you. Move to the quietest spot you can, sit down, and take slow breaths with me: in through your nose, out through your mouth. I’m staying with you, and I’m getting a live agent now.
slottedCanonicalQueryTemplates: Hi, I’m sorry, I can’t really breathe right now, there’s so much noise in here and I keep losing what you said.
